question: Has gap G002 already been addressed: No controlled comparison varies both the base retriever and the form of the temporal signal: each published temporal-retrieval system hard-codes one temporal mechanism inside one pipeline (exponential decay inside a fixed three-signal hybrid; learnable decay inside graph-based retrieval; a hard as-of boundary inside a multimodal verifier), and the temporal pathologies are asserted to be architecture-agnostic without a transfer measurement. It is therefore unknown whether temporal re-ranking gains persist across BM25, dense and hybrid retrievers, and whether graded recency decay or valid-time membership is the appropriate signal for amended normative text.?
rationale: A gap is only a hypothesis until a targeted search fails to find work that closes it.
